title: Metastatic impact of perfluorooctanoic acid on liver cancer: insights from HepG2 cells and zebrafish xenograft models
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00491H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kayla E. Hawn, Emma Kenyon, Gregory Buck, Wei Xu
Widely used in consumer products for its water- and grease-resistant properties, perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), a legacy per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS), has been increasingly implicated in liver carcinogenesis.
